profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Real Time Engineering | Elixir
profile.summary: I’m a senior software engineer with a knack for building reliable systems and helping teams do their best work. Before becoming an engineer, I spent years in leadership roles, which means I care just as much about people, communication, and clarity as I do about code. I thrive on collaborative teams that value creativity, empathy, and shared ownership. I love environments where curiosity is encouraged and good ideas can come from anywhere. I take my work seriously, but not myself, and I think a little humor goes a long way. At my best, I’m building great software alongside people who genuinely enjoy working together.
